name: Mail connectors
description: Lists inbound and outbound connectors with the domains, smart hosts or IP addresses they cover and their TLS settings.

parameters.name: OnlyEnabled
parameters.label: Only enabled connectors
parameters.help: Leave out connectors Exchange reports as disabled. A connector whose state is unknown is kept.

prerequisites: ExchangeOnlineManagement 3.7.0 or later installed through your organisation's approved process, and an Exchange role that can read organisation configuration.
limitations: Runtime support follows the ExchangeOnlineManagement module's documented support; not yet tested in a tenant.
Every connector is read; a tenant normally has only a few.
A TLS setting returned empty is shown as NotSet. What Exchange does when none is set is not inferred.
Connector validation and certificate checks are not run.
A true or false value Exchange did not return is shown as Unknown, never as False.
The roles listed follow Microsoft's documentation and have not been confirmed in a tenant.
